gate:install-sandbox: local sandbox probe; CI runs gate:install on the install-gate job
gate:install:self-test: self-test of the gate, not the product; run on the install-gate job via --self-test when that job's own files change
gate:multi:self-test: self-test of the multi-agent sim; the live sim is the multi-agent job
gate:soak: hours-long stability probe; too slow for gate.needs
gate:soak:self-check: fixture check for soak, not a merge gate
gate:soak:record: writes a soak recording; not a merge gate
gate:conformance:self-test: self-test of the conformance runner; the conformance job runs the gate
test:coverage: coverage report, not a merge verdict
test:bench: already part of test:unit, which verify and unit-tests run
